summary: Serve queued merge-group CI jobs before pull-request jobs

replay.detail: Workflow runner routing only; no projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, migrations, indexes or schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, writer admission or coordinated member rules changes.

compatibility.detail: Member eligibility, runner shapes, shared cache keys, daemon and client protocols are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or interruption is introduced.

manual.detail: CI administrators may enable CI_MERGE_CI1=on only after Ops confirms the dedicated ci1-merge pool, existing shared cache and KVM support; all merge jobs then use that pool. Alternatively, set CI_MERGE_NAMESPACE_PROFILE only after provisioning a profile with the existing Linux image, KVM and shared cache and capacity outside the PR pool. Unset switches retain existing shapes with merge-first priority. Existing daemon installations require no action.

recovery.detail: Reverting the workflow routing restores its previous scheduling; no stored data or migration rollback is involved.
